name: Quran Observatory
author: lAvArt Studio
description: Today's Quranic root in the bar, from quranobservatory.org: its meaning and occurrences, example verses, the collocation burst, concordance rings, a concordance, the Quran structure map, and an offline root search.

barWidget.description: Today's root in the bar; click for its verses, statistics and a root search.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What the bar shows for today's root. Vertical bars always show the icon.

schema.label: Bar style
schema.description: Chip sets the widget apart from the clock and indicators beside it with a faint, softly rounded frame. Plain is text only.

schema.label: Show occurrences
schema.description: Adds how many times the root occurs in the Quran to the bar label, for example 196×.

schema.label: Download root data
schema.description: Fetches the root index and concordance (about 3.5 MB) from quranobservatory.org and keeps it in ~/.cache. Today's root and search then work offline; what you type is never sent anywhere. Off makes no network requests, so with no saved copy the widget stays empty.

schema.label: Arabic font
schema.description: The font for roots and verses, for example Noto Naskh Arabic, Amiri or Scheherazade New. It has to be installed.
